_comment: Hand-verified ground truth for a subset of psm Nix modules. Each entry was manually read from the source file and transcribed. This provides an INDEPENDENT check against the regex-based oracle_nix_pubsub.py, which shares patterns with the Go extractor and therefore produces inflated (~1.0) F1 against the same extractor.
_caveat: Small (~5 services) — adequate to catch systemic extraction bugs, not a statistical recall baseline. Expanding the set is a reasonable follow-up.

services.pub_source: imperative (hardcoded `pubmsg canstatd` in script; no baf.pub_topic mkOption)

services.sub_source: declarative baf.sub_topics base list only (21 entries). Excludes conditional ++ appends for fuserd/trackerd, lift/lift-aux-fuel, haild, payload.

services.sub_topics_partial_note: The trackerd module has its own sub_topics list; additional topic "simd" is added cross-file via nix/hardware/common/nazgul-radar-services.nix  `redacted.services.trackerd.additional_sub_topics = [ "simd" ]`. Verify both files are captured.
